friction.headline: What owners tell Liam before they start
friction.body: The same handful of struggles come up again and again in the first call.

list.quote: My dog lunges, barks or reacts around other dogs or people.
list.response: Reactivity has a cause. Liam builds a structured plan around what's actually driving it, not just the symptom.

list.quote: Walks feel stressful, unpredictable, or I've stopped enjoying them.
list.response: The goal is a dog whose needs and drives are actually being met, so walks feel calm again.

list.quote: I want my working or protection dog trained properly from the start.
list.response: Liam has worked with some of the country's most difficult dogs and trains a completely tailored approach across all four quadrants of operant conditioning.

faq.headline: What to know before you call.

list.question: What training methods does Liam use?
list.answer: A completely tailored approach across all four quadrants of operant conditioning, built around the dog in front of him rather than one method for every dog.

list.question: Can you help with reactivity or aggression?
list.answer: Yes — reactivity and aggression cases are one of Liam's core focuses; share what's happening so it can be discussed properly at the consultation.

list.question: Do you offer residential / board and train?
list.answer: Yes, for existing clients whose dogs need a structured, higher-level programme — residential training starts from £150/day (minimum 1 week, crate trained).

list.question: What ages and breeds do you work with?
list.answer: Liam works with a wide range of ages and breeds, including working and protection-line dogs; share your dog's age, breed and history when you get in touch.

list.question: What does training cost?
list.answer: 1-2-1: £150 first session, or 3 sessions (3.5 hrs) for £275. Follow-up 1-2-1: £75/hour. Group classes: £20 per household (existing clients). Home visits: £200/hour + £1/mile.

story_blocks.headline: Reactivity and aggression cases are one of his greatest passions.
paragraphs: With over 12 years of experience, Liam has worked with some of the country's most difficult dogs and achieved genuine, transformative results. Reactivity and aggression cases are one of his greatest passions — a completely tailored training method across all four quadrants of operant conditioning to build a fully conditioned dog he trains for. Beyond 1-2-1 and residential training, Liam also offers sport dog coaching and dog sourcing services for owners looking to start with the right dog from day one.

He is deeply committed to sharing his knowledge, speaking regularly at seminars and workshops alongside some of the biggest names in dog training, and drawing on an extensive network of breeders, decoys and working-dog professionals.
